lineage.description: The dataset aggregates IDP counts collected through IOM's Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) methodology across three baseline assessment rounds in Armenia. DTM employs systematic surveys and key informant interviews at sub-national levels to enumerate and characterize displaced populations, producing displacement impact records linked to the 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh conflict.
